Simple on the Surface. Rocket Engine Underneath.

Most timeline tools force an unfair trade-off: spreadsheets break the moment one date slips, commercial Gantt suites lock basic features behind $15–$49/user/month paywalls, and asking ChatGPT to code an HTML/Mermaid chart gives you a static, broken picture you cannot drag or update.

Jantt removes every barrier at once:

Promise What It Means for You
No Code Needed Drag bars visually, resize deadlines, connect arrows, or describe your plan in plain English to the built-in AI Copilot. You never have to write a single line of code or JSON unless you want to.
Free Forever + Free Cloud Rooms 100% MIT open source. Use offline in your browser with zero sign-up, or sign in free with GitHub for real-time multi-user cloud rooms, shareable links, and unlimited exports.

Create and Edit Gantt Charts with AI (Built-In Copilot)

Stop wrestling with spreadsheet rows or begging chatbots for fragile SVG/React code. Jantt ships a built-in AI Copilot directly inside the live workspace: just open the Copilot drawer and describe what you want in plain English.

How It Works in 3 Steps

  1. Describe or Paste Anything in Plain English: Type a goal, paste messy meeting notes, or ask to push deadlines, flag urgent risks, rebalance workloads, or add milestones.
  2. Review the Visual Diff Preview: Jantt validates the AI's structured output against its strict schema and displays an exact added / updated / removed diff preview before touching your schedule. Zero surprise overwrites.
  3. Apply in One Click: Accept the change with full Undo / Redo support. Dependencies automatically cascade, working days recalculate, and all 6 views update immediately.

Bring Your Own Key (10 Providers) or Run 100% Free & Local

Your API keys stay strictly in your browser's localStorage and connect directly to your provider: never through a Jantt proxy. Live dynamic model discovery (/models and Ollama /api/tags) automatically fetches the latest models from your account with instant search and context-window tags.

Built for Everyone: Real-World Use Cases

Jantt is not just for Fortune 500 schedulers or software engineers. Open the live app and start organizing whatever matters to you right now:

Organizing for Students, PhD/MS Applicants & Researchers

  • University & Scholarship Pipelines: Track PhD/MS deadlines, GRE/IELTS prep, Statement of Purpose drafts, recommendation letter reminders, and application fees in one calm timeline.
  • Semester, Thesis & Exam Planning: Map coursework, lab experiments, advisor sign-off milestones, and revision weeks, then flip to Checklist View each morning to tick off today's work with one click.
  • Zero Cost for Students: Free forever, instant browser auto-save, and one-click JSON/CSV/PDF backup for advisor check-ins.

Personal Life Organizers, Freelancers & Everyday Planning

  • Life Milestones Made Visual: Plan weddings, moving apartments, home renovations, international travel itineraries, fitness/learning sprints, or side-hustle launches without fighting messy spreadsheets.
  • See What Matters Today: Hit the Today jump button or toggle the 1-click focus bar (Today, This Week, Date Range) with Dim Mode (softly fades other tasks) or Hide Mode so big plans never feel overwhelming.
  • Built-In Budget Tracking: Track estimated vs. actual spending on every task to see whether your personal project is under or over budget at a glance.

Meetings, Standups, Agencies & Small Teams

  • Turn Chaotic Meetings Into Clear Commitments: Paste raw meeting minutes into the AI Copilot to generate tasks, owners, dates, and dependencies before the call even ends.
  • Collaborate in Free Cloud Rooms: Sign in free with GitHub to turn any local plan into a live shared room with Owner, Editor, and Viewer permissions, @username mentions, and instant multi-user sync.
  • Share Anywhere in One Click: Send a compressed read-only snapshot link, embed an interactive chart, or export a clean multi-page Executive HTML/PDF report for clients and leadership.
  • Notes Right Next to Tasks: Keep Markdown meeting notes, specs, and decisions pinned alongside the timeline with clickable @person and /task references.

Engineering Teams & Program Managers

  • Working-Calendar-Aware Critical Path (CPM): Schedule cascades, Critical Path, float calculations, Resource Leveling, and DCMA-14 audits all honor the same working calendars: Mon-Fri (standard), Mon-Thu (compressed_4x10), 24/7 (continuous), US/UK/EU/CA/AU regional statutory holidays, custom named calendars, and per-person calendars.
  • Full ANSI/PMI Dependency Math: Finish-to-Start (FS), Start-to-Start (SS), Finish-to-Finish (FF), and Start-to-Finish (SF) links with positive lags, negative leads, and locked: true hard milestones.
  • No More Expensive Legacy Viewer Seats: Import and export Microsoft Project .xml and Oracle Primavera P6 .xer schedules directly in the browser or CLI.
  • Executive Analytics Built In: Earned Value Management (EVM: ANSI/EIA-748), DCMA-14 schedule health grading (A-F), PERT 3-point estimates, 5,000-run Monte Carlo risk simulation, and automated Resource Leveling with preview before apply.

Developers & Autonomous AI Agents

  • JSON-as-Interface (10x Fewer LLM Tokens): Instead of asking AI models to hallucinate brittle React JSX or SVG coordinate math, models emit clean, validated Jantt JSON conforming to a formal JSON Schema (schema/v1.json).
  • Official MCP Server (@jantt/mcp): Connect Claude Desktop, Cursor, Gemini, or custom AI agents directly to 6 deterministic scheduling tools (jantt_inspect_plan, jantt_add_task, jantt_reschedule_task, jantt_audit_schedule, jantt_diff_plans, jantt_export_csv).
  • Embed Anywhere: First-class packages for React, Vue 3, Svelte 4/5, Web Components, Plain HTML, Python / Jupyter / Streamlit, Yjs CRDT, 60 FPS Canvas, and a two-way live-sync CLI.

Free Cloud Collaboration and Zero-Lock-In Privacy

Use Jantt completely offline with zero account, or collaborate live with teammates for free:

  • Instant Local Mode (Zero Account): Open the web app and start building immediately. Every edit auto-saves locally in your browser, and every view remembers your scroll, zoom, and filters.
  • Free Real-Time Cloud Rooms: Sign in with GitHub OAuth (minimal read:user scope: no passwords, no Google tracking) to claim your @username, create live shared cloud rooms, invite collaborators with Owner, Editor, or Viewer roles, and merge concurrent edits safely via ACID transactions and a 3-way CRDT reconciler.
  • Compressed Share Links: Share any plan as a self-contained, fflate-compressed URL snapshot: zero server required for read-only viewing.
  • Zero Database ID Leakage: sanitizePlanForJson recursively strips private UIDs, secrets, and room tokens before any write or export. Only clean canonical @username mentions appear in JSON.
  • Dual-Mode People Manager: Assign tasks to real @username collaborators or offline personas (clients, contractors, advisors) without requiring them to create an account.
  • Portable Forever: Import or export raw JSON, RFC-4180 CSV, Microsoft Project .xml, Oracle Primavera P6 .xer, standalone SVG, or print-ready Executive HTML/PDF Booklets anytime.
Technical Details: Firebase RTDB Security Rules & Architecture
  • GitHub-Only Auth: Restricted to GitHub OAuth 2.0 (read:user scope). Automatically registers your verified GitHub handle into /usernames/{username} on first sign-in.
  • Security Rules (database.rules.json):
    • /users: Indexed on username (.indexOn: ["username"]) for live prefix search; users may only write their own record.
    • /usernames: Atomic handle registration preventing username collisions.
    • /user_rooms: Fast dashboard listing of owned and shared cloud rooms.
    • /rooms: ACID transactions via runTransaction with 3-way CRDT reconciliation; only owners and editors can mutate plan state.
  • Optional Verification Gate: ENABLE_GITHUB_VERIFICATION_GATE in apps/playground/src/firebase/githubVerificationService.ts (off by default) supports optional public follower/star checks using no additional OAuth scopes.

Enterprise Scheduling Engine Under the Hood

Every calculation is written in strict TypeScript, verified by 1,290+ automated unit and integration tests plus Python bridge tests:

Algorithmic Engine Standard / Math What It Does
Topological DAG Cascade $O(V + E)$ Tarjan SCC + topological sort Cascades FS/SS/FF/SF links with lags/leads; respects locked: true milestones and isolates cycles safely without crashing.
Working-Calendar CPM 2-pass AON + mixed-calendar longest-path Computes ES, EF, LS, LF, Total Float, and Free Float on each task's resolved calendar (task -> person -> project -> Mon–Fri), honoring regional holidays (US, UK/GB, EU, CA, AU) and custom shifts without splitting mixed-calendar critical paths.
Resource Leveling Priority- & float-aware capacity solver Detects resource over-allocations per person/capacity and previews conflict-free schedule shifts before you apply them.
Earned Value (EVM) ANSI/EIA-748 (PV, EV, AC, CPI, SPI, EAC, TCPI) Tracks cost and schedule variance across your budget with honest forecasting.
DCMA-14 Schedule Audit Selected DCMA 14-point checks (A–F grade) Flags missing logic, leads, lags, non-FS links, hard constraints, high float (>44 working days), negative float, high duration, out-of-sequence progress, and broken links.
PERT & Monte Carlo Risk $\mu = \frac{O + 4M + P}{6}$, 5,000+ stochastic runs Computes probabilistic completion dates (P50 / P80 / P90), on-time deadline confidence, and task criticality index off the main thread in a Web Worker.

Developer and AI Agent Quickstarts

Embed Jantt into any web app, notebook, CLI pipeline, or AI agent in under 60 seconds:

1. React (@jantt/react)

npm install @jantt/react @jantt/core

import { Jantt } from "@jantt/react";
import "@jantt/core/theme.css";

const projectData = {
  meta: { title: "Product Launch", calendar: "standard", showCriticalPath: true },
  categories: { core: { label: "Core Engineering", color: "#38BDF8" } },
  tasks: [
    { id: "t1", label: "Architecture RFC", category: "core", start: "2026-09-01", end: "2026-09-14", progress: 1.0 },
    { id: "t2", label: "Core Implementation", category: "core", start: "2026-09-15", end: "2026-10-15", dependsOn: "t1" }
  ]
};

export default function Timeline() {
  return <Jantt data={projectData} themeClassName="jantt-theme-dark" onCommit={(next) => console.log(next)} />;
}

2. Vue 3 (@jantt/vue)

npm install @jantt/vue @jantt/core

<script setup>
import { JanttTimeline } from "@jantt/vue";
import "@jantt/core/theme.css";

const props = defineProps(["plan"]);
const handleCommit = (updatedPlan) => console.log("Committed:", updatedPlan);
</script>

<template>
  <JanttTimeline :data="props.plan" theme-class-name="jantt-theme-dark" @commit="handleCommit" />
</template>

3. Svelte 4 / 5 (@jantt/svelte)

npm install @jantt/svelte @jantt/core

<script>
  import { janttAction } from "@jantt/svelte";
  import "@jantt/core/theme.css";
  export let plan;

  const options = {
    themeClassName: "jantt-theme-dark",
    onCommit: (next) => (plan = next)
  };
</script>

<div use:janttAction={{ data: plan, options }} style="width: 100%; height: 600px;" />

4. Framework-Agnostic Web Component (@jantt/elements)

Drop directly into PHP, Ruby on Rails, Django, Laravel, WordPress, or plain HTML:

<script type="module" src="https://unpkg.com/@jantt/elements/dist/jantt-elements.js"></script>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/@jantt/core/dist/theme.css" />

<jantt-timeline
  data-src="/api/plan.json"
  theme="swiss-dark"
  scale="day"
  show-critical-path="true">
</jantt-timeline>

5. Plain HTML / Script Tag (@jantt/standalone)

No bundler or build step required:

<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/@jantt/standalone/dist/style.css" />
<script src="https://unpkg.com/@jantt/standalone/dist/jantt.standalone.iife.js"></script>

<div id="timeline" style="width: 100vw; height: 600px;"></div>

<script>
  window.Jantt.mount("#timeline", projectData, { themeClassName: "jantt-theme-dark" });
</script>

8. Terminal CLI with Two-Way Live Sync (@jantt/cli)

Always invoke via the scoped package (npx @jantt/cli), or install globally with npm install -g @jantt/cli for the jantt binary:

# Open interactive browser timeline with live 2-way auto-save back to disk
npx @jantt/cli open ./project.json --port 3000

# Run DCMA-14 schedule health, working-calendar CPM & EVM audit
npx @jantt/cli audit ./project.json

# Run 5,000 Monte Carlo probabilistic risk iterations
npx @jantt/cli monte-carlo ./project.json --runs 5000

# Export to MS Project XML, Primavera P6 XER, CSV, SVG, or Executive HTML/PDF
npx @jantt/cli export ./project.json --format xml --out ./project.xml
npx @jantt/cli export ./project.json --format html --out ./executive-report.html

# Import enterprise schedules back into Jantt JSON
npx @jantt/cli import ./schedule.xer --out ./project.json

9. Headless Engine (@jantt/core), Interop (@jantt/interop), Canvas (@jantt/render-canvas) & CRDT (@jantt/yjs)

Show code snippets for Headless Core, MS Project / Primavera Interop, 60 FPS Canvas & Yjs Multiplayer

Headless Core Engine (@jantt/core)

import { resolveSchedule, calculateCriticalPath, validate, exportToCsv } from "@jantt/core";

const validation = validate(rawJson);
if (!validation.valid) console.error("Schema errors:", validation.errors);

const options = {
  defaultGapDays: rawJson.meta?.defaultGapDays ?? 2,
  calendar: rawJson.meta?.calendar,
  useWorkingDays: rawJson.meta?.useWorkingDays,
  calendars: rawJson.calendars,
  people: rawJson.people
};

const resolvedTasks = resolveSchedule(rawJson.tasks, options);
const { criticalTaskIds, projectTotalFloat } = calculateCriticalPath(resolvedTasks, {
  ...options,
  targetDate: rawJson.meta?.targetDate
});
const csvData = exportToCsv({ ...rawJson, tasks: resolvedTasks });

Enterprise MS Project, Primavera P6 & Executive Report Interop (@jantt/interop)

import {
  exportMsProjectXml,
  importMsProjectXml,
  exportPrimaveraXer,
  importPrimaveraXer,
  exportExecutiveReportHtml
} from "@jantt/interop";

const msXml = exportMsProjectXml(plan);
const p6Xer = exportPrimaveraXer(plan);
const reportHtml = exportExecutiveReportHtml(plan.tasks, {
  title: plan.meta?.title ?? "Executive Status Report",
  theme: "corporate",
  defaultGapDays: plan.meta?.defaultGapDays,
  targetDate: plan.meta?.targetDate,
  calendar: plan.meta?.calendar,
  useWorkingDays: plan.meta?.useWorkingDays,
  calendars: plan.calendars,
  people: plan.people
});
const importedPlan = importMsProjectXml(msXml);

High-Performance 60 FPS Canvas Engine (@jantt/render-canvas)

import { CanvasTimelineRenderer } from "@jantt/render-canvas";

const renderer = new CanvasTimelineRenderer(hugePlan, {
  dayWidth: 36,
  rowHeight: 34,
  showCriticalPath: true
});
renderer.render(ctx, { scrollX, scrollY, width, height });

Real-Time Multiplayer CRDT (@jantt/yjs)

import * as Y from "yjs";
import { bindJanttToYDoc, createJanttUndoManager } from "@jantt/yjs";

const doc = new Y.Doc();
const binding = bindJanttToYDoc(doc, {
  initialPlan,
  onPlanChange: (plan) => render(plan)
});

binding.updateTask("t1", { progress: 0.85 });
const undoManager = createJanttUndoManager(doc);
undoManager.undo();
